kept.name: TestParentDirectiveScans_SyntheticRows
kept.reason: proves each parent-directive scan fires on a stencil that breaks its rule, which the scans over the real stencils cannot show while those stencils comply

kept.name: TestRegistry_DefaultsAndRelPathAreConsistent
kept.reason: pins that RelPath resolves each registered name to its real file and that the Bouncer templates stay registered, which the scans over stencil bodies do not

kept.name: TestRegistry_MatchesOnDiskTree
kept.reason: pins that the registry and the on-disk stencil tree name the same stencils in both directions, which no other test compares

kept.name: TestSkillLoadViolations_SyntheticRows
kept.reason: proves the skill-load scan fires on a stencil that breaks the rule and stays quiet on a bare pointer, which the scan over the real stencils cannot show while those stencils comply

kept.name: TestStencils_NameNoConstraintsFile
kept.reason: pins the ban on a stencil naming the retired CONSTRAINTS.md, a guard that fires which the repository-relative citation rule cannot see

kept.name: TestStencils_NoEditRuleRestatement
kept.reason: pins the rule that only the edit-directive stencil states the edit rule, a guard that fires which no other test asserts

kept.name: TestStencils_NoSkillLoadInstructions
kept.reason: pins PATTERN-stencil-ownership's parent-directive ban on a stencil telling an agent to load a skill that lym delivers, or naming the Skill tool, a guard that fires which no other test asserts

kept.name: TestStencils_NoUnboundedAskOperator
kept.reason: pins PATTERN-stencil-ownership's parent-directive ban on an unbounded ask-the-operator sentence in a spawned role's stencil, a guard that fires which no other test asserts

kept.name: TestStencils_OpeningStencilsRenderEditDirective
kept.reason: pins PATTERN-stencil-ownership's parent-directive marker on every role's opening stencil, a guard that fires which no other test asserts

kept.name: TestStencils_OpeningStencilsRenderParentDirective
kept.reason: pins PATTERN-stencil-ownership's parent-directive marker on every role's opening stencil, a guard that fires which no other test asserts

kept.name: TestStencils_TopLevelMarkers
